items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: because Pete Wendel and Max Cortlander had the piano rolls with "Downhearted Blues" on it.

ctx.x: No, I was well known, because I was in fact what you call -- well, what people call famous, from my records. Because if you know, "Downhearted Blues," my record for Paramount, was the first blues ever to sell 100 percent mechanical. They were on every phonograph label, and that's
what I told you to remind me of the player pianos, because Pete Wendel and Max Cortlander had the piano rolls with "Downhearted Blues" on it.
